selection: Purposive selection by three prose types before generation; not random or representative of the entire novel.
intervention: Replace only the first three paragraphs of the current production translation-policy.txt with one faithful/natural translation sentence. The remaining production contract, source, context, glossary, model and runner are identical.
blinding: A/B display key prepared before generation; assistant analysis is not a blind or independent human evaluation. User review remains unfilled.
criteria: 事实、指代与逻辑是否完整准确
声音、节奏与原文意象是否保留
是否出现原文没有的增饰或解释
decision_rule: Discuss concrete gains and regressions per sample; no numerical superiority threshold, p value, or whole-book claim from one draw per cell.
stop_rule: One successful output per cell. Preserve failed attempts. Do not rerun successful cells to select a preferred result.
limits: No test of the whole literary-translate skill or all historical prompts
No test of source transcription or revision pipeline
No reference translations or current book Chinese are provided to generation calls
Platform base instructions and pretraining are not eliminated
